title: Close-out PR body no longer lists commits a run inherited from its submitted base
description:
tk cloud pr-body enumerated every commit on the run branch the run did not create (cargo from a submission made off a branch ahead of default). ticks deleted it and ticfac's closeout_body.go carries only the review verdict and findings, so that cargo is now silent in the epic PR body. The entrypoint prompt and image/README were reworded to stop promising it.

ticfac run epic-6in filed this backlog tick from the finding e4e4e16eb51a476df084424ccdf7208d939c9e0f134125c9ffa27768b2ac5b56 (reported by run-epic-6in/tick-46x/attempt-4): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-6in/absorptions/e4e4e16eb51a476df084424ccdf7208d939c9e0f134125c9ffa27768b2ac5b56.json on the run branch.
notes: 2026-09-28 12:18 - ticfac run epic-6in: created by absorbing finding e4e4e16eb51a476df084424ccdf7208d939c9e0f134125c9ffa27768b2ac5b56 — a backlog tick: the done is reachable with the finding standing. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-6in/absorptions/e4e4e16eb51a476df084424ccdf7208d939c9e0f134125c9ffa27768b2ac5b56.json on epic/6in, and it says: the epic's acceptance is prose (the acceptance carries no [A<n>]-marked items, so its definition of done is prose: nothing is runnable, nothing can be pointed at, and whether a finding gates it cannot be decided — refusing to absorb rather than guessing. Mark the acceptance into stable [A<n>] items first (ticks goal-design.md, fact sheets), then decide absorption against them.), so there is no item the reporter's claim could gate and no judgement for a person to make: the finding is backlog work, filed as a tick with an owner. The reporter does not claim it breaks the build or CI, the one claim that gates a prose done
